## Request Context
- **What was requested**: /review of Phase 1 of SPEC-20260607-183136 (Layer B live dashboard daemon) per the autonomous workflow — quality gate passed 7/7, build discussion sealed, code ready for independent multi-agent evaluation before commit. No push.
- **Files/scope**: NEW scripts/telemetry/dashboard_server.py (~470 lines FastAPI app, 127.0.0.1 hardcoded bind + runtime guard + HostHeaderGuard + same-origin CORS + read-only DB + lifespan + generic errors); NEW src/telemetry/live.py (~620 lines pure event-fold model); extended src/telemetry/dashboard.py (+220 lines live-panel renderers); NEW src/telemetry/static/htmx.min.js (vendored 1.9.12, SHA384 recorded) + README; A-ARCH1 promotion in scripts/ingest_token_usage.py (rename 3 privates to public) + 5 call-site updates; NEW tests/test_dashboard_server.py (30 invariant tests); +29 tests in tests/test_telemetry.py; ADR-0020 amended with Layer B live-daemon form-factor note; memory/bugs/regression-ledger.md +4 entries.
- **Developer-stated motivation**: The shipped static Layer B dashboard categorically cannot show live agent lanes / context runway / per-turn cost / in-flight orphan detection (form-factor gap per ANALYSIS-20260607-rh-oversight-deepdive.md). The Telemetry & Oversight north star is a live dashboard for understanding AI use; A1/A2/A3 are the data foundation. Steward APPROVE 0.86 form-factor gate overturns DISC-20260607-063709 with 9 binding conditions (= AC1-AC9). This is the FIRST telemetry component that binds a port = network-attack surface = HIGH risk.
- **Explicit constraints**: NO push to any remote; NO auto-merge; carries all 9 Steward conditions; HARDCODED_HOST 127.0.0.1 literal + no --host flag + no HOST env read + runtime guard before uvicorn.run(); CORS same-origin only + Host header validation (DNS-rebinding); html.escape via _esc seam; vendored frontend assets (NO CDN); read-only DB (file:...?mode=ro); live.py pure (no scripts.* imports, no transcript IO); generic errors (no DB-path/exception class leakage); no outbound HTTP client; ASCII-safe in console paths; Ross-repo contamination guard (MIT-licensed, but DO NOT lift verbatim JS or reuse fixtures); Phase 1 explicitly defers AC11 (authored fixture transcripts → Phase 2), AC12 (--render-static parity → Phase 5), AC13 (cost-from-tokens × pricing → already structural via A1 read-side reuse).

Verdict: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES, confidence 0.87. Strong invariant test discipline for AC1-AC9 Steward conditions. 7 findings: F1 (HIGH missing-test) — 6 live-panel renderers in dashboard.py have zero direct render tests; the escape test only verifies HTTP route output, not amber/red runway class emission, lane-class row classes, empty-state absence tiles, runway-estimate <strong> markup; F2 (MED semantic) — _render_runway_panel uses _LANE_STATUS_LABEL.get(runway.status, runway.status) for a runway status; the fallback coincidentally produces correct CSS but is semantically wrong (runway statuses not in lane label dict); F3 (MED missing-test) — _parse_main_session / _parse_subagent in dashboard_server.py have only one integration test; dispatch event emission from tool_use/Agent, result event emission from tool_result, the since timestamp filter, the subagent JSONL path, OSError on unreadable file all uncovered; F4 (MED missing-edge-case) — AC3 behavioral guard skips when .claude/hooks absent — CI portability gap; create minimal stub fixture in tmp_path; F5 (MED missing-test) — CORS same-origin-only is configured but not asserted by test; no OPTIONS preflight test with foreign Origin; F6 (LOW) — since parameter boundary (strict < vs <=) untested; F7 (LOW) — retrospective_fragment's general Exception branch untested (only OperationalError covered).

Verdict: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES, confidence 0.91. 9 Steward conditions structurally sound; tests load-bearing; middleware ordering correct + verified; static traversal blocked by Starlette commonpath. 2 findings: F1 (LOW supply-chain advisory) — vendored htmx SHA384 is README-documented but NOT machine-verified by any test; test_static_htmx_asset_is_served only asserts presence + 'htmx' in body; a backdoored swap-in would pass; recommendation: add @pytest.mark.regression test that hashlib.sha384 + base64-encodes htmx.min.js and asserts equality with the pin from README; F2 (LOW observation) — no Content-Security-Policy header on responses; given vendored assets + aggressive _esc seam, low priority for loopback-only tool but defense-in-depth would benefit from default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'unsafe-inline' (inline CSS). All adversarial probes (Host header missing, path traversal, error paths, runtime bind bypass, escape coverage, lifespan close-on-exception) verified clean. Defense-in-depth on bind is real: three layers (no --host flag, runtime guard, post-Config check). htmx SHA384 independently verified correct.

Verdict: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES, confidence 0.86. R14 purity OBVIOUS, R15 single render path real, A-ARCH1 used as spec demanded, dependency direction clean. 4 findings: F1 (MED pattern-inconsistency) — A-ARCH1 public surface is internally inconsistent: parse_timestamp + coerce_int are also consumed by the daemon (lines 200, 215-218, 259, 274-277) but lack the 'Promoted to public in the A-ARCH1 promotion' docstring footer the other 4 carry. ADR claim 'A contract test locks the public surface' becomes incomplete by omission. Recommendation: add the footer + include in contract test (one-line edit per fn), optional __all__ entry; F2 (MED drift, anticipatory) — lazy-per-request fold has NO event-source seam (Protocol / callable parameter / app.state.event_source) — Phase 2 background watcher will require route-handler rewrite rather than swap. Recommendation: add event_source: Callable[[], list[LiveEvent]] | None = None parameter to create_app, default to current behavior; Phase 2 swap = one constructor arg, ~5 LOC; F3 (LOW dead-code) — dashboard_server.py:128 _connect_readonly is duplicated from scripts/telemetry/dashboard.py:88 and UNUSED in current routes (daemon delegates to assemble_dashboard_data); delete now per Principle #8, promote when 2nd actual consumer appears; F4 (Info) — verify A-ARCH1 contract test scope matches F1 recommendation. Strengths: arch F1/F2 honest-absence accounting correctly separated; mark_orphans non-call comment names Phase 2 prerequisite correctly.

Verdict: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES, confidence 0.82. Strong honest-absence vocabulary, runway gauge uses 3 simultaneous non-color channels, role=progressbar ARIA correct, microcopy warm + non-judgmental, escaping protects UI from runaway subagent corruption. 6 friction points: FRICTION-1 (HIGH dead-end) — first-paint loading state visually IDENTICAL to honest-absence tile (no .tile[data-state=loading] CSS rule); if htmx fails to load (e.g. static dir missing), user sees a dashed tile indistinguishable from 'analyzer not run'; add pulsing-opacity animation + change copy to 'Connecting to live session data - updates every 3s'; FRICTION-2 (HIGH visual-hierarchy) — main session row has zero visual differentiation from dispatched subagent rows; spec asks 'would a developer recognize at a glance which row is the main session' and answer is no without reading raw lane_id column; add primary badge + subtle green tint on first active row (color + position, WCAG-safe); FRICTION-3 (MED accessibility/UX) — _render_runway_panel uses _LANE_STATUS_LABEL fallback for runway sub-line so manager-gatekeeper sees raw 'amber'/'red' constant names instead of human labels; define _RUNWAY_LABEL = {OK: 'OK', AMBER: 'warning', RED: 'critical'} (also resolves qa F2 semantic confusion); FRICTION-4 (MED dead-end) — /fragments/retrospective is LIVE route but NOT reachable from the shell UI; user has no way to discover the retrospective view without reading source; add nav link or embed below live section via second polling section; FRICTION-5 (LOW) — Live stream 'Kind' column shows raw 'message'/'dispatch'/'result' internal event names; add 1-line legend mapping; FRICTION-6 (LOW platform) — _otel_link opens new tab without warning; change label to 'enable OpenTelemetry (opens in new tab)'.

Verdict: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES, confidence 0.87. Strong knowledge-persistence at primary artifacts (ADR amendment, spec, ledger, docstrings, static README). 4 findings: F1 (MED missing-adr/undiscoverable) — FRAMEWORK_SPECIFICATION changelog has no entry for ADR-0020 (entire Telemetry & Oversight component invisible to the spec; the syncing-framework-docs skill cross-refs this). Add 2 changelog rows: 2026-06-05 for ADR-0020 / Telemetry stack, 2026-06-07 for Layer B live daemon form-factor reversal; F2 (LOW format-inconsistency) — new Steward gate (DISC-20260607-163709) + spec-review (DISC-20260607-183247) entries in ADR-0020 Linked Discussions use IDs without discussions/<year>/ path prefix that other entries use, making them non-navigable; also update original static gate line 324; F3 (LOW claude-md) — CLAUDE.md Pointers section has no entry for Telemetry & Oversight or Layer B live dashboard; a developer reading the constitution has no entry point for 'how does the framework observe its own cost?'; add: 'Telemetry & Oversight (ADR-0020): cost (A1), failure signals (A2), value-vs-subscription (A3), Layer B live dashboard -> scripts/telemetry/dashboard_server.py; pure model -> src/telemetry/'; F4 (LOW knowledge-stuck, /promote candidate) — leverage fabricated-zero bug from REV-20260607-075429 is a generalizable display-surface honesty pattern (key absence on numerator measured, not denominator configured); promote to memory/lessons/ with developer approval per Principle #7. Strengths: regression-ledger entries exemplary (explain WHY each invariant matters + name canary tests); module docstrings document invariants at the seam; static README pins SHA384 + update procedure.

Verdict: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES, confidence 0.74. Instance: Independent Analyst. The 4-stage approval cascade (Steward / spec review / 2 build checkpoints) DID surface security + purity concerns correctly — those are clean and well-tested. The cascade FAILED to surface ONE concern: the lazy-per-request fold reads ALL 94MB of this repo's transcript root (255+ subagent JSONLs) every 3s, with NO since-cutoff — and the since parameter is plumbed through 3 functions UNUSED (Chekhov's gun: the author knew the problem existed and deferred it). On this very repo's first launch this likely produces a stuttering / blank-fragment / stale-by-one-cycle UI. Spec line 219 'Phase 1 is independently shippable' assumes a usable page in <3s. Premortem-1 HIGH likelihood. Premortem-2 MED: htmx default behavior on 500 is to SWAP NOTHING — the carefully-written 500 error fragment will NEVER reach the user; tests pass because TestClient is not htmx. Premortem-3: spec arch F5 disposition says old scripts/telemetry/dashboard.py 'retired INTO --render-static mode' (Phase 5 deferred), but the old script is still present + functional; dual-existence contradicts the spec. Premortem-4 LOW: _connect_readonly tested + defined but routes don't use it (route delegates to assemble_dashboard_data); the locally-tested guard is decoupled from the production path. FORM-FACTOR REVERSAL: I went looking for confirmation bias and found none — the deep-dive's structural-gap analysis is rigorous, no alternative is better. That convergence was real evaluation. Required (blocks usability not security): (1) wire the existing since param from /fragments/live to _extract_live_events with default 'now-10min' + filter discover_session_dirs by mtime; (2) verify htmx swap-on-500 behavior; either return 200+data-state=error or set hx-swap-error on shell. Recommended: resolve dual-existence of scripts/telemetry/dashboard.py; nice-to-have: monkeypatch sqlite3.connect regression; docstring honesty edit on _extract_live_events.

Finding verification: 21 advisory findings (0 BLOCKING). All findings reference specific file:line locations that I cross-verified against the actual source: qa F1/F2/F3 verified (renderer functions present and uncovered; _LANE_STATUS_LABEL misuse at line 681 confirmed - addressed in advisory fix #2); security F1/F2 verified (no SHA384 test - addressed in fix #3; no CSP header confirmed); arch F1/F2/F3 verified (parse_timestamp/coerce_int public but undocumented; lazy-fold has no event-source seam; _connect_readonly unused); ux FRICTION-1 through 6 verified by code reading; docs F1/F2/F3/F4 verified against the cited file locations; independent-perspective Pre-Mortems 1-4 verified by code reading + 94MB transcript root measurement. 5 fixes applied pre-commit (since param wired, _RUNWAY_LABEL dict, htmx SHA384 regression test, ADR linked-discussion paths, hx-swap-error). 16 remaining findings tracked as advisory in BUILD_STATUS for Phase 2 work.

## Request Context
- **What was requested**: /review of Phase 1 of SPEC-20260607-183136 (Layer B live dashboard daemon) per the autonomous workflow before commit. No push.
- **Files/scope**: NEW scripts/telemetry/dashboard_server.py + NEW src/telemetry/live.py + extended src/telemetry/dashboard.py + NEW src/telemetry/static/htmx.min.js + A-ARCH1 promotion + 30 invariant tests + 29 live tests + ADR amendment + 4 ledger entries.
- **Developer-stated motivation**: First telemetry component binding a port = network-attack surface. Steward APPROVE 0.86 + 9 binding conditions.
- **Explicit constraints**: 9 Steward conditions = AC1-AC9; no push; no auto-merge.

Verdict: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES (5 specialists APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES + 1 APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES = consensus). 21 advisory findings, 0 BLOCKING. Cross-specialist convergence on 5 high-priority items — ALL applied pre-commit: (1) lazy-fold-on-94MB usability (indep + arch F2): wired the existing-but-unused since parameter with a 10-minute lookback + mtime filter inside _extract_live_events; (2) runway label semantic (qa F2 + ux FRICTION-3): added _RUNWAY_LABEL dict separating runway statuses from lane statuses; (3) supply-chain integrity (security F1): added @pytest.mark.regression test asserting machine-computed SHA-384 of vendored htmx matches the README pin; (4) ADR linked-discussion paths (docs F2): added discussions/2026-06-07/ prefix to the 2 new entries; (5) htmx swap-on-error (indep #2): added hx-swap-error='outerHTML' on shell so the honest-error fragment reaches the user. Quality gate 7/7 after fixes (230 tests pass).

16 remaining findings tracked as advisory for Phase 2 / follow-up: live-panel renderer tests (qa F1), parse-layer tests (qa F3), AC3 CI portability (qa F4), CORS preflight test (qa F5), since boundary test (qa F6), retrospective Exception branch (qa F7), CSP header (security F2), A-ARCH1 surface completeness (arch F1), event-source seam (arch F2), unused _connect_readonly (arch F3), loading state CSS (ux FRICTION-1), main lane visual differentiation (ux FRICTION-2), retrospective view reachability (ux FRICTION-4), live stream Kind legend (ux FRICTION-5), OTel new-tab warning (ux FRICTION-6), FRAMEWORK_SPECIFICATION changelog (docs F1), CLAUDE.md Pointers (docs F3), leverage pattern promotion candidate (docs F4), dual-existence of old static dashboard.py (indep #3), sqlite3.connect monkeypatch (indep #4), docstring honesty edit (indep #5).

Confidence annotation: 1 finding in speculative section (independent-perspective confidence 0.74 < 0.80 — anti-groupthink instance, all findings retained in main findings section per the recommendation that prior cascade missed concrete usability concern; the lazy-fold finding led directly to the most impactful pre-commit fix). 0 findings retained as unscored.

Model tiers: facilitator:opus, qa-specialist:sonnet, security-specialist:sonnet, architecture-consultant:sonnet, ux-evaluator:sonnet, docs-knowledge:sonnet, independent-perspective:opus (default --cost medium / mixed).
